#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class FastReader {
public:
    istream& in;
    string buffer;
    size_t pos;

    FastReader(istream& input_stream) : in(input_stream), pos(0) {}

    string next() {
        while (true) {
            if (pos >= buffer.size()) {
                getline(in, buffer);
                pos = 0;
                if (in.fail()) return "";
            }
            while (pos < buffer.size() && isspace(buffer[pos])) ++pos;
            if (pos >= buffer.size()) continue;
            size_t start = pos;
            while (pos < buffer.size() && !isspace(buffer[pos])) ++pos;
            return buffer.substr(start, pos - start);
        }
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
};

int main() {
    FastReader fr(cin);
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int T = 1;
    for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
        int n = fr.nextInt();
        int mod = fr.nextInt();

        vector<vector<long long>> dp(n, vector<long long>(n * n + 5, 0));
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (size_t j = 0; j < dp[0].size(); j++) {
                for (int cnt = 0; cnt <= i; cnt++) {
                    if (j >= cnt) {
                        dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][j - cnt]) % mod;
                        if (dp[i][j] == 0) dp[i][j] += mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        vector<vector<long long>> sums(n, vector<long long>(dp[0].size(), 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            long long sum = 0;
            for (size_t j = 0; j < dp[0].size(); j++) {
                sum = (sum + dp[i][j]) % mod;
                if (sum == 0) sum += mod;
                sums[i][j] = sum;
            }
        }

        vector<long long> fact(501 * 501, 1);
        for (size_t i = 1; i < fact.size(); i++) {
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        }

        vector<vector<long long>> ncr(501, vector<long long>(501, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i <= 500; i++) {
            ncr[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                ncr[i][j] = (ncr[i - 1][j] + ncr[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
            }
        }

        long long result = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - 2; i++) {
            int cnt = n - i;
            int pre = n - cnt;
            long long comb = (ncr[n][pre] * fact[pre]) % mod;
            long long totalSum = 0;
            vector<long long>& last = dp[cnt - 2];
            long long ssum = 0;
            long long total = 0;
            for (size_t j = 2; j < dp[0].size(); j++) {
                total = (total + sums[cnt - 2][j - 2] * (cnt - 1)) % mod;
                long long temp = last[j] * total % mod;
                result = (result + temp) % mod;

                ssum = (ssum + sums[cnt - 2][j - 2]) % mod;
                if (j - cnt - 1 >= 0) {
                    ssum = (ssum - sums[cnt - 2][j - cnt - 1] + mod) % mod;
                }

                total = (total - ssum + mod) % mod;
            }
            result = (result + (sums[cnt - 2][0] * comb) % mod) % mod;
        }

        cout << result << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
